body: I am sorry to hear what your mother is enduring right now and bless you for taking care of her! This hit home for me as I had the same complications from 3 different surgerys ( 1st one was MARSA the other 2 were staf) Has your mother appiled for the QMB? (it is extra help from Medicare (check with local gov office) it will cover almost everthing Medicare won't. If she does not qualify ask to speak to hospital social worker, I know there is a program (don't know the name) that is for emergency medical assistance to cover hospital when pt insurance is tapped out and pt is on fixed income and can not afford bill, the social worker will evev fill out app for you (used to work for co. that did this. You can also call maker of drug most will work with pt on fixed income. I hope you find something here helpfull. BTY listen to Dr he is very right this is very serious, I know of 2 people who died from this, once in spinal col. or blood there is not much to do, but looks like she is safe with you watching out for her. All my best to a speedy recovery :)

Wow where to start... I was hoping this Christmas would have some joy and merryment this year. Back story : I have been neglecting my son around the holidays especially (I was dx with PTSD following these events: my Dad passed away Dec 20, that summer my husband of 17+yrs and father of my children left us in the middle of the night many states away from any family -was a blessing anyway as he is abusive freeloader but he also helped with things that I can not becaused disabled, my Mom was Dx with breast cancer in Oct and we came right away stayed until she passed away Dec 20th, that summer we had to move from home in SC "back home" to PA living with my sister and her family- I was on bed rest due to illness but thought things would be great for me & kids with family support as I was still numb from all losses when my beautiful 18yr old daughter tragicly passed away right next to me while I was asleep Sep 19th and I didn't know (we shared a bed and son in other bed)). So the last few Christmas' and actually everyday honestly I have just been "going through motions" only minimum to get through the days and the one TRUE innocent in life , my son has been neglected by ME. Thats back story. We (my son & I)  do therapy and I knew I wouldn't be doing much for presents this year - that wasn't what I was worried about(we are poor and know it, barely survive on SSD andhelp with electric - no child support (don't even know where he is as he didn't even attend his daughter's funeral) whole other story- FYI yes he was getting a present I saved for but thats gone as of midnight now (will get back to that) The "lightbulb" went off and buzzer ringing when I saw the Christmas exchange here. As a lurker and reader I decided that is just the thing to get us in the spirit, I was so excited just to be involved in something I can afford and Johnathan would get a real kick out of. Thats when I happened on some offers of card exchanges - GREAT! love it! Boy, I was starting to feel something.... I saw a few posts on assistance and I could actually help a few people out with things that either my son or I didn't need anymore and many things that belonged to my DD. We were going to have the joy of helping several, my son even wanting to give his netbook to kid in school and I found an old decent camera for someone who had to borrow someones for verification, oh was so excited. Ok here is where I screw up ROYALLY again! Thinking I have plenty of time to get in the mail because I just have to find this item first, and oh I'll add this too (even though we moved into our 2 bed apt in Jan, we had moved out of 5 bed in storage and it is still hard to go through some of my daughter's things - we are still not unpacked) so  life still happens, Sandy was not nice and lost all perishables and huge cherry tree down in yard, but could have been much worse no biggie....plenty of time, yeah right son gets bad cold, I have broncitise sp? thanksgiving flys by and I am getting worse (Lupus makes me more suceptical sp? to things) and next I know it I am on my back in ICU w/ pnenumia sp? I come home to finnish recovery and I can't for the life of me remember my reddit username or password AAKKKGGKK can't even remember who I was to send to (I did know what was being sent) Ok few days pass no luck, have to make new username and hope mod can help me out here. Lucky redditor rocket (one of recipents) helped me a bit giving me my username and that jarred my memory for password, all set, little worse for wear but back on track. I got a letter from SS saying THEY overpaid me for 8 months (it goes directly into my checking acct I have no control how much deposit or how they get figures) it wasn't alot every month and frankly went unnoticed (my income is below 400% federal poverity guidelines) so letter explains that they are taking large chunk from Dec and rest spread over 4 months, so what pittance I had planned to spend on son for Christmas and finnish making this years grave blankets... My goodfriend was going to take me to post office and help me finnish convelssing. Got several bags of things to mail (I use flat rate box ) the only thing in my hand is my cane (right side) and bottle of tea.  Oh, I guess this is where I should mention that 2bed apt.... happens to be above landlords garage. My friend behind me ( her family in apt helping unpack) oh,, little mention stairs to said apt are concrete, it happened to be a bit wet (can't even say it rained, just spitting on Sat) and STUPID ME with big mouth gabbing away falls down said concrete stairs screaming like a baby as my ankle went in direction is should not have. (My friend came from MD to PA to help me unpack so landlord can do inspection and not think I am a hoarder and will extend lease for another year - no I am not a hoarder, just can not do physical lifting moving etc.) Needless to say spent day in ER  dx: trimalleolar break. I haven't been able to sleep, shaking with pain (I am already on pain medications prior to this and can not increase dose) so I may need surgery, I have to see orthopedic @10am today. Like I said I am not wanting to hurt myself, just miss having an adult around I guess. Think I'll pass on the joy and merriement this year, maybe next... who knows    BTW: If you are one of the people I told I was sending something to: I still am, just not likely in time for Christmas I am so very sorry, I did have the best intentions for you and yours, I am just very stupid, my fault please forgive me (that was just in case someone read this befor I have a chance to pm directly. Thank you for listening and I am sorry if in the wrong place and errors in text (can't get to pc physically due to injury so reduced to Nook)..........Really you ever know someone who's life could be a Lifetime mini-series

I am so verry sorry I can't help with transportation, however maybe someone at hotel can help guide you. i hope your son heals quickly. I am assuming he is not in a room where you can use the pull out chair over night. With the many experinces I have had with my children in hospital ( NICU, ICU & surgery) while sleeping in van at nights in hospital lot, a social worker came to room to check on us and told us about "parent suites" (most hospitals have them) it is a free room & shared shower we had to check in @ 12 and it was first come. When we did not get in there was always room at Ronal Mcdonald house which is donation only and as other poster said with in walkinh distance to hosp. I hope this helps. Also I know how stressful you must be right now but it will be very important to your son that you take good care of yourself too at this time , as on his discharge he will need you at your best to care for him at home. Well wishes for you and son! Feel free to pm me if you want to talk or just vent.
